name: tunneltend-website
description: The TunnelTend product website and user manual at tunneltend.com.

scripts.build: npm run assets:generate && astro build && node scripts/finalize-public-routes.mjs
scripts.test: npm run brand:check && npm run check && node scripts/check-manual-verify.mjs && node scripts/check-workflow-credentials.mjs && node --test scripts/public-routes.test.mjs scripts/theme-preferences.test.mjs scripts/check-compatibility-output.test.mjs ../tools/compatibility/*.test.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/check-output.mjs && node scripts/check-compatibility-output.mjs
scripts.check:publish: node scripts/check-publish.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/check-output.mjs
